## Example checklist (for new/modified examples)

- [ ] README follows the template in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] `.env.example` lists all required environment variables
- [ ] Python runs with `python main.py`
- [ ] TypeScript runs with `npx tsx index.ts`
- [ ] No API keys or secrets in committed files
- [ ] Example runs in under 5 minutes
- [ ] Type hints (Python) / strict types (TypeScript)
- [ ] Error handling implemented
- [ ] Colored status messages for terminal output
